verified_facts.text: The resort has 17 chef-led restaurants and bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: 17 CHEF-LED RESTAURANTS & BARS

verified_facts.text: Ciel Spa is a 20,000 sq ft destination spa with massages, facials, body treatments, a hydrotherapy circuit and a full-service salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 20,000 sqft destination spa offering a curated selection of massages, facials and body treatments in addition to an immersive hydrotherapy circuit and full-service salon.

verified_facts.text: Swim-out rooms sit along a winding river pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step out of your room and into the water, in rooms perched along a winding river pool.

verified_facts.text: Rooftop jacuzzi rooms are bi-level, with a private rooftop deck, jacuzzi, lounge and panoramic sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: These bi-level rooms feature a private rooftop deck with a jacuzzi, lounge and panoramic sea views.

verified_facts.text: SLS Elite guests receive personal butler service, private check-in, and preferred pool and beach areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: SLS Elite rooms and suites come complete with personal butler service and private check-in, pool and beach

verified_facts.text: Twiggy by La Cantine is an adults-oriented restaurant and pool club whose pool is open daily to guests over 18, with multiple jacuzzis and a central swim-up bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: The pool is open daily to guests over 18 and features multiple jacuzzis, a central swim-up bar, sun-loungers, an exclusive SLS Elite area and private cabanas.

verified_facts.text: Smoke & Mirrors is a bar influenced by South American speakeasies, serving spirits alongside fine cigars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Influenced by South American speakeasies, serving smooth liquor and spirits alongside a world-class offering of fine cigars

verified_facts.text: Coati Kids Club is a dedicated space for ages 4 to 12 with a weekly rotation of activities from arts and crafts to robot building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Coati Kids Club is a dedicated space for ages 4–12, where imagination runs wild and high-energy play is encouraged, with a weekly rotation of activities from arts and crafts to robot building.

verified_facts.text: The Teen Lounge for ages 12 to 17 has billiards, video games and activities from Fortnite tournaments to water polo.
verified_facts.excerpt: with billiards, video games and a program of activities from Fortnite tournaments to water polo. For ages 12–17

verified_facts.text: A kids splash zone with slides, sprinklers and tipping buckets sits alongside the family pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The water playground of kids’ dreams sits alongside the family pool for endless hours of aquatic play. Slides, sprinklers and tipping buckets

verified_facts.text: The resort has an indoor movie theatre.
verified_facts.excerpt: INDOOR MOVIE THEATRE

verified_facts.text: SLS Sculpt offers two 24/7 gyms and group classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two 24/7 gyms and a schedule of group classes balance the indulgence.

verified_facts.text: Playa Mujeres Golf, an 18-hole par-72 course designed by Greg Norman, is minutes from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Greg Norman, Playa Mujeres Golf is an 18-hole, par-72 masterpiece only minutes from SLS

verified_facts.text: The resort is all-inclusive, covering all meals and drinks across the restaurants and bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Everything is included, from your coffee, smoothie or buffet in the morning, to your poolside lunch, afternoon gelato and your steakhouse dinner.

verified_facts.text: Some upgrade options, such as SLS Elite, are available for additional fees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Double down on extraordinary with options that make your stay next-level, available for additional fees.

verified_facts.text: The resort sits within a double-gated community with multiple security checkpoints.
verified_facts.excerpt: Multiple security check-points offer peace of mind from the moment you arrive.

verified_facts.text: Childcare is available day and night with support from Cancun Nancy Service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available day and night, with support from the highly-experienced Cancun Nancy Service.

verified_facts.text: An on-site convention center has 10 flexible spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: a pre-function foyer for private registration and custom configurations to suit every need, across 10 flexible spaces.

verified_facts.text: SLS Playa Mujeres is the first all-inclusive resort in the SLS portfolio.
verified_facts.excerpt: SLS Playa Mujeres is the first all-inclusive resort in the SLS portfolio

verified_facts.text: The Envy Three Bedroom Suite has three king bedrooms with ensuites and an outdoor terrace with sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three king bedrooms with ensuites, lavish living and dining spaces, and an expansive outdoor terrace with sea views

verified_facts.text: SLS Playa Mujeres was named in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2025 and 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2025, 2026

verified_facts.text: Kosher dining is available through the Liora program.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor exceptional kosher dining at SLS Playa Mujeres through our Liora program.
